Name: James Patterson's Women's Murder Club
Description: Join Detective Lindsay Boxer and the Women's Murder Club to crack a string of San Francisco murders in this hidden-object crime thriller based on James Patterson's best-selling novels. Comb crime scenes for evidence, beat the clock, and follow the leads from the lab to the courtroom.

Achievements.Name: Lab Investigation
Achievements.Description: The player has viewed the cutscene saying that Jennie Kwong's body is to be taken to the lab.

Achievements.Name: Investigation Complete
Achievements.Description: The player has successfully completed every investigation in the game.

Achievements.Name: Crime Scene Investigator
Achievements.Description: The player has completed levels on all 8 crime scenes.

Achievements.Name: Keeping It Together
Achievements.Description: During gameplay, the player has paused the game and accessed the Investigation Docket.

Achievements.Name: Lady MacGyver
Achievements.Description: The player has used an inventory item within a scene.

Achievements.Name: Sharp-shooter
Achievements.Description: The player needs to select 3 items in a single crime scene inside a 5 second time-frame.

Achievements.Name: Elementary
Achievements.Description: The player only made 5 mistakes, or less, in completing the investigation.

Achievements.Name: Methodical Investigation
Achievements.Description: An investigation was completed by identifying every object in the order displayed on the HUD.

Achievements.Name: Quick Worker
Achievements.Description: A player completes a scene in half of the time allotted to complete the scene, or less.

Achievements.Name: Eagle Eye
Achievements.Description: The player completes an investigation scene having never used the zoom functionality on that scene.

Achievements.Name: Lightbulb
Achievements.Description: The player must complete three consecutive scenes without using any hints.
